description: This file defines the Relationship class used to manage and represent relationships between modules in the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM system. It includes methods for checking existence, deletion, retrieval, caching, and relationship traversal, and it manages relationship metadata.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: Represents and manages relationships between modules in the CRM system, providing methods for relationship integrity, caching, and navigation.

methods.name: is_self_referencing
methods.description: Checks if the current relationship is self-referencing based on table and key comparison.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether a relationship with the given name exists in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the relationship as deleted in the database.

methods.name: get_other_module
methods.description: Retrieves the module on the other side of a specified relationship.

methods.name: retrieve_by_sides
methods.description: Retrieves a relationship record based on the sides (lhs and rhs modules).

methods.name: retrieve_by_modules
methods.description: Retrieves a relationship name based on the involved modules and optional type.

methods.name: retrieve_by_name
methods.description: Loads relationship metadata into the object based on its name.

methods.name: load_relationship_meta
methods.description: Loads relationship metadata from cache, building the cache if necessary.

methods.name: build_relationship_cache
methods.description: Builds and caches the relationships metadata.

methods.name: cache_file_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where relationship cache files are stored.

methods.name: cache_file_name_only
methods.description: Returns the filename used for relationships cache.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes the relationships cache file and invalidates the cache.

methods.name: trace_relationship_module
methods.description: Follows a relationship chain starting from a base module to another related module based on relationship attributes.
